top_configuration_example.return_concentration_observation: All realized return in this A result came from the sole hit ticket; therefore the observed A ROI is maximally single-hit concentrated.

top10_structure_observation.note: Several profile variants produced identical A realized metrics, showing that the final SINGLE/FK10 path collapsed multiple upstream profile settings to the same realized path on Segment A.

segment_B.preregistered_b_pass_rule: realized_roi > 0 AND bet_race_count >= 50 AND maximum_drawdown <= 0.35 AND no_negative_bankroll
segment_B.interpretation: No A_TOP10 configuration satisfied the complete preregistered B validation gate. This does not imply every day or every subperiod was negative.

diagnostic_conclusions: The frozen 784-configuration lineage did not establish a generalizable economic edge because no configuration passed Segment B.
The strongest Segment-A result was highly return-concentrated: 148 bet races and one hit ticket produced all 45790 JPY of realized return.
Daily loss is not itself a failure criterion; the next lineage should explicitly measure weekly and monthly profitability/stability rather than requiring every day to be positive.
DEV2000 contains only 15 unique dates in A and 8 unique dates in B, so it is too short to establish robust monthly stability by itself.
